scope: Final Lever 3 stop/readiness artifact. It generalizes the reusable deployment-safety gate, records the final P07658 fixed-threshold scoring closure status, and stops current-family Lever 3 optimization until new family panels or exact P07658 coordinate/provenance arrive.

reusable_parts: Use predicted-structure/source-free evidence only for deployment safety decisions.
Select counteraxes only on train/calibration evidence; never tune on heldout or application rows.
Keep threshold 0.44155 locked unless a separate authorized threshold process exists.
Route hard confounded lookalikes to abstain_or_route_novel_oos instead of forcing mechanism labels.
Disallow mechanism transfer until the target family has exact coordinate/provenance, source-free features, calibrated negative controls, and reproducibility/source-hash audits.
Record provenance for every source artifact, coordinate path, checksum, provider/model/version, and input sequence hash.
Fail closed whenever exact evidence is missing, stale, source-derived, label-derived, or not reproducible.
family_specific_parts_not_universal: The five current route classes and their row counts are current702 evidence, not universal family rules.
The current cofactor/same-family, fold-similarity, pocket-geometry, pocket-chemistry, and protein-descriptor counteraxes are not assumed to transfer to new families.
Current family-specific hard residual rows are safely routed but not converted into mechanism-transfer permissions.
P07658 is a current-family fixed-threshold scoring closure blocker, not a general blocker for future family expansion gates.
new_family_gate_steps: Freeze the family panel, source boundaries, train/cal/heldout split, and admissible source-free feature set before fitting or selection.
Materialize predicted structure inputs and coordinate/provenance sidecars with exact sequence hashes and documented nonstandard residue handling.
Run train/cal-only counteraxis selection against family-appropriate confounders and hard negatives.
Verify calibration retention and OOS abstain/route behavior at the locked operating point without heldout tuning.
Apply the gate to application rows only as an operator action: retain if supported, otherwise abstain_or_route_novel_oos.
Build source-hash, lineage, and normalized rebuild audits before any operator use.
Allow mechanism transfer only after family-specific evidence passes provenance, reproducibility, calibration, confounder, and leakage audits.
evidence_required_before_mechanism_trans: Exact target sequence and predicted coordinate/provenance, including path and checksum.
Input sequence hash match to the frozen family manifest.
Documented treatment of nonstandard residues such as P07658 U140.
Train/cal-selected source-free counteraxis evidence with heldout and application rows excluded from selection.
Family-specific hard-negative and unsafe-lookalike evidence showing safe abstain/route behavior.
No use of mechanism text, labels, EC/Rhea IDs, source IDs, target names, or experimental-PDB metadata as predictive features.
Reproducibility audit with source hashes current and zero normalized rebuild differences for operator-facing artifacts.

exact_missing_evidence: Exact full-length P07658 predicted coordinate for the frozen 715-aa sequence.
Filled provenance with provider/model/version/path/checksum and input sequence hash.
Explicit U140 selenocysteine preservation or handling documentation in the provenance.
Passing P07658 acceptance preflight before any fixed-threshold scoring rerun.
routes_not_retried_this_run_because_equi: ESM Atlas public Fold API rejected the exact full-length sequence by length limit.
Hugging Face router/legacy routes lacked usable unauthenticated access.
BioLM and NVIDIA routes required credentials not present in the environment.
SWISS-MODEL repository returned PDB-provider rows rather than a deployment-valid predicted coordinate.

allowed_future_inputs_to_resume: A new frozen family panel for Lever 4/family expansion processed through this gate.
An exact full-length P07658 predicted coordinate plus filled provenance that passes acceptance preflight.
disallowed_future_work_until_allowed_inp: Forced mechanism transfer for unsafe lookalikes.
P07658 scoring without exact coordinate/provenance and passing acceptance preflight.

interpretation.headline: Lever 3 is finalized as a reusable deployment-safety gate, not a current-family forever project.
interpretation.result: Safe abstain/route operator use is current and reproducible; fixed-threshold scoring closure remains fail-closed only because P07658 lacks exact full-length predicted coordinate/provenance.
interpretation.next_action: Stop current-family Lever 3 optimization. Resume only with a new family panel processed through the gate or exact P07658 coordinate/provenance that passes acceptance preflight.
